definitions.inputs: 8 = 4 brains MF283..MF286 + their exact left-right mirrors (suffix f); n = 4 independent brains
definitions.source_volumes: mri/data/_crossmodal/<arm>__<MOD>[_vr]__<id>.nii.gz: each input's canonical payload pushed through the arm's composed full warp by eval_crossmodal.py (tensors: vecreg-canonicalised, tag _vr)
definitions.in_sample: the measures of record: eval_oldmetrics.eval_arm (template = mean of all 8 inputs) and eval_crossmodal (mean over all 28 pairs); reproduced here to abs_tol before anything else
definitions.leave_self_out: reference for input s of brain b = mean of the 6 inputs of the other 3 brains (s and its mirror excluded); built as eval_oldmetrics builds the template: T2 each input scaled to mean 1000 in the whole support then plain mean; FRAC plain mean; tensor log-Euclidean mean (eigenvalue floor 1e-6 x median MD of MF283/MF283f, as in eval_oldmetrics); a brain and its mirror share one reference
definitions.T2_NMI: FSL-like Parzen NMI (H(A)+H(B))/H(A,B), 64 bins, robust 0.5/99.5 pct rescale, on the whole support (template/mri/linc_mri_core_t2); _WM on template/mri/linc_mri_wm_fa025
definitions.FRAC1_MAE: mean |soma fraction - reference| on linc_mri_core_micro (paper's 'fraction MAE'); FRAC2 = neurite
definitions.DTI_OVL: Basser-Pajevic tensor overlap with the reference, mean over the whole support; _WM on linc_mri_wm_fa025
definitions.fiber_angle_deg: mean angle between principal eigenvectors of a pair of inputs, in the deliverable core (mmsym_model_dti coverage >= 0.999, eroded 6) with final-template FA > 0.25 (the white-matter rule of the 14 Oct 2026 revision)
definitions.B0_r: Pearson r between the warped b0 images of a pair of inputs, in the deliverable core
definitions.mask_dice: Dice between a pair of warped model masks (>= 0.5), whole grid
definitions.per_brain_template: mean of the brain's two inputs (brain and mirror)
definitions.distinct24_mean: mean over the 24 pairs between distinct brains (= mean of the 6 unique brain-pair means, 4 pairs each)
definitions.per_brain_distinct: mean over the 12 distinct-brain pairs that involve the brain (or its mirror); NOT independent across brains (each pair enters two brains)
definitions.paired_four_channel_vs_t2tensor: per brain: four-channel (mmsym_model_dti_v) minus T2 + tensor (tbl_t2dti_v); exact bootstrap = all 4^4 = 256 resamples of the 4 brains with replacement, equally weighted, quantiles by numpy linear interpolation; n = 4, so the interval is descriptive
definitions.corrected: leave-self-out for template-referenced measures, distinct-brain pairs for pairwise measures
definitions.rankings: arms ordered best first by the arm mean; 'moved' = arm: [in-sample rank, corrected rank]
